Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — super helpful to see how Redwood handles long-context summarization and the KV cache behavior we discussed. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can prepare the trial: 

What matters most for us (success criteria):
- Precision on clinical note summaries: average ROUGE-L > 0.65 across our sample set (primary gate)
- Latency: p95 token latency under 220ms for 1–2k token sequences during steady state
- No PHI exfiltration; logs and access controls must meet our compliance checklist

Next / asks:
1) Can you send a short evaluation plan with owners, dataset slices, and pass/fail gates?
2) Proposed trial window — we were thinking ~4 weeks and would like a mid-trial checkpoint.
3) Can we schedule an exec readout for the decision stage (go/no-go) so our CISO & Head of Clinical Ops can attend?

Attached is a rough internal POC brief (bridgewell_poc_plan_v1.pdf) that shows the datasets and sample queries. My procurement lead, Michael Dunn (cc'd), will need the preliminary pricing/SOW once we land on scope.

Tentative timeline on our side: start week of Dec 7 or Dec 14 depending on final prep time.

Thanks —
Alyssa

Hi Alyssa —

Really appreciated the conversation yesterday. I pulled together a concise evaluation plan and owners below; attached is a proposed exec readout agenda for the final decision. High level: we can run a 4-week trial starting Dec 8 if Bridgewell can provide the labeled sample sets and grant the sandbox access by Dec 7. If that's tight, we can shift start to Dec 14.

Evaluation plan (owner):
- Data ingest & masking verification (Karthik Iyer) — validate PHI handling and masking on ingest + KMS keys
- Model runbook & metrics instrumentation (SoOjin Lee) — token-level latency, ROUGE/L metrics, hallucination checks
- Clinical sample evaluation (Bridgewell + Jordan Blake) — run agreed 200-case sample set and annotate pass/fail

Success gates (pass = all must be met):
- Quality: ROUGE-L >= 0.65 average AND no >5% catastrophic errors on core summary fields
- Latency: p95 token latency < 220ms during 95% of test window
- Security: Redwood audit logs accessible to Bridgewell SOC; KMS-backed key control in place

Milestones & timeline:
- Dec 7: final data access + sandbox credentials delivered by Bridgewell
- Week of Dec 8 (kickoff): baseline runs + instrumentation configured
- End of Week 2 (Dec 21): mid-trial checkpoint — preliminary metrics and blockers
- End of Week 4 (Jan 4): final readout materials ready and exec slot (two-week exec scheduling buffer accounted for)

Owners & roles:
- Redwood: Soojin (trial owner), Karthik (security/compliance lead), Jordan (clinical evaluation lead)
- Bridgewell: Alyssa (trial sponsor), Michael (procurement & SOW)

Immediate asks for Bridgewell:
- Confirm sandbox start date (Dec 8 vs Dec 14)
- Share the 200-case sample set and the list of fields that must be preserved in summaries

I'll propose internal availability for an exec readout week of Jan 11–15; attached is a one-page agenda we can expand. If you're aiming for a decision earlier, we can compress the timeline but will need core team availability for extra validation runs.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

— Soojin
